preconditions.description: The number of registration requests n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 32 for name in requests)
preconditions.description: Each name in the requests must be between 1 and 32 characters long.
All characters in each name must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of responses must equal the number of registration requests.

postconditions.expression: all(response == 'OK' or response.startswith(request) for request, response in zip(requests, responses))
postconditions.description: Each response must be 'OK' or a new name starting with the requested name.

postconditions.expression: all(response != 'OK' or response not in requests[:i] for i, response in enumerate(responses))
postconditions.description: If a response is 'OK', the name must not have been previously registered.
